checks.text: The page heading reads "Contact Book" and, with no contacts saved, the table area shows the text "No contacts yet".

Clicking the button "Add contact" opens a form; filling the field labelled "Name" with "Ada Lovelace", the field labelled "Email" with "ada@example.com", and the field labelled "Phone" with "555-0101", then clicking "Save", adds a row to the table containing "Ada Lovelace" and "ada@example.com"; the text "No contacts yet" is gone.
Typing "ada" in the input labelled "Search" filters the table to show only the row containing "Ada Lovelace"; typing "zzz" in the same input shows the text "No contacts match".

Clicking the button "Edit Ada Lovelace" opens the form pre-filled with "Ada Lovelace" in the Name field; changing the Name field to "Ada King" and clicking "Save" updates the table row to show "Ada King" and "ada@example.com".
Clicking the button "Delete Ada King" removes that row from the table and the table area shows "No contacts yet".

After adding a contact with Name "Bob Smith", Email "bob@example.com", and Phone "555-0102", clicking the column header "Name" in the table sorts rows so "Ada Lovelace" appears before "Bob Smith"; clicking "Name" again reverses the order so "Bob Smith" appears first.
Clicking the button "Export CSV" downloads a file whose content includes the header row "Name,Email,Phone,Notes" and a line containing "Ada Lovelace,ada@example.com,555-0101,".
Filling the field labelled "Notes" with "Met at conference" for a new contact and saving, then clicking "Edit" on that contact, shows "Met at conference" in the Notes field.
Reload keeps the contact "Ada Lovelace" visible in the table after the page is reloaded.
